| Page | Lanes | Deployments | Points | Hardware |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GLM-5.2 | 14 (was 16) | 34 (was 32) | 75 (was 74) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| GLM-5.3 | 1 | 1 | 10 | B300 |
| DeepSeek-V4 | 12 | 26 (was 25) | 70 (was 68) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1 | 9 | 22 | 67 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.5 | 17 | 49 | 219 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 4 | 5 | 24 | GB300, B300, B200, H200 |
| Muse Spark Open | 6 | 9 | 63 (was 61) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |

- **GLM-5.2 NVFP4 GB200 Dynamo+SGLang ([InferenceX #4398](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4398), in progress).** Image `nightly-dev-20261020-ab580b2e` (pinned by digest), MTP 5-1-6.
  - Agg: TP4 and TP8 (2 nodes) points.
  - Disagg: PP8 prefill (2 nodes) with TP4 or DEP8 / DEP16 decode, in 1P6D, 1P4D, 1P2D, 1P1D, 2P1D and 3P1D shapes. These replace the DEP8-prefill MTP deployments.
- **DeepSeek-V4-Pro FP4 GB300 Dynamo+SGLang ([InferenceX #4401](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4401), in progress).** Image `nightly-dev-20261019-3c560089` (pinned by digest).
  - Agg: TP4 and TP8 (2 nodes) DSpark points.
  - Disagg: PP8 prefill (2 nodes) with DEP16 / DEP12 / DEP8 decode, in 1P1D and 2P1D shapes. These replace the DEP8-prefill 1P1D–4P1D deployments.
  - Workers add `--no-speculative-enable-w4a4-mxfp4-megamoe`: the draft model stays on W4A8 MegaMoE while the target runs W4A4.
- **Muse Spark Open B200 / GB300 / B300 SGLang ([InferenceX #4400](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4400), [#4404](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4404), [#4417](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4417), in progress).** All three move to image `nightly-dev-20261021-c1c287a4`.
  - B200 adds a c64 point.
  - GB300 and B300 retune their concurrency points.
- **DeepSeek-V4 B300 Dynamo+SGLang ([InferenceX #4346](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4346)), Qwen3.5 GB300 Dynamo+SGLang ([InferenceX #4333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333)).** Same `/use` runs as in #45749. **From InferenceX `main`**
- **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 Dynamo+SGLang ([InferenceX #4303](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4303), merged).** Now measured on `main` (run 39695060576), at the same commit #45749 and #45495 showed.
- **GLM-5.2 FP4 B200 SGLang ([InferenceX #4394](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4394)).** Image `v0.5.22-cu130`.
- **GLM-5.2 FP8 B200 ([InferenceX #4389](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4389)), GLM-5.3 B300 ([InferenceX #3930](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3930)).** Merged with the commands #45749 showed. Now verified from `main`.

**Colocated workers**

Some deployments start several workers on one node:
- DeepSeek-V4.1 GB300 disagg: two DEP2 prefill workers per 4-GPU node.
- GLM-5.2 B200 disagg: two TP4 decode workers per 8-GPU node.
- Qwen3.5 GB300 / B200 / B300 disagg: prefill and decode on one node, or two decode workers per node.

SemiAnalysis's launches gave each of them its own GPUs and ports. The page now does too:
- **Several colocated workers in one role.** The worker tab starts with a `LOCAL_WORKER_RANK` preamble. It sets `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`, `PORT` (+32 per rank, srt-slurm's spacing: SGLang derives further ports from `--port`), `BOOTSTRAP_PORT` (+1) and the KV-event endpoint. The note under the tab lists each worker's rank.

- **A single colocated worker** (e.g. the decode worker of a one-node 1P1D) shows its offset ports directly, e.g. `--port 30032`.
- **SGLang router URLs** in the derived variant use the same per-worker ports.
- **Placement note.** These cells carry a note that the GPU count covers the GPUs the workers use, so whole nodes should be reserved.

**Relation to #45495.** That PR hand-edited the DeepSeek-V4.1 GB300 disagg cell. This sync replaces the edit with generated data:
- **Kept:** the per-worker GPU pinning, distinct ports, the 2-port KV-event stride and a Placement note.
- **Changed:** the cell again offers the derived no-offload / HiCache tiers next to the measured Mooncake tier, labeled "derived", like every other cell.
- **Removed by existing rules:** `--enable-metrics`, `DYN_SYSTEM_PORT`, `PYTHONUNBUFFERED` and `MC_STORE_CLIENT_METRIC_INTERVAL`. The Dynamo system server is off by default, so dropping `DYN_SYSTEM_PORT` cannot make colocated workers collide.

`_agentx.jsx` changes only text: the worker note for blocks with `local_ranks`, and the `LOCAL_WORKER_RANK` placeholder description (no longer prefill-only).

**Flag rules added:** `--no-speculative-enable-w4a4-mxfp4-megamoe` (keep, kernel selection) and `UCX_CUDA_IPC_ENABLE_MNNVL` (keep, UCX CUDA IPC over multi-node NVLink for NIXL, [InferenceX #4398](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4398)).

- Every page in a headless browser (`mint dev`, Mintlify 4.2.559 as in CI). Every hardware / checkpoint / deployment / concurrency / KV tier / router combination renders exactly the decoded commands: 2,814 command sets, 0 mismatches, 0 unseen, no browser errors. Every tab was clicked, and every "Copy link" URL was reopened. The section links from the Deployment panels and the copy buttons were also checked.
- The component's own decoder reproduces every generated plan (2,814 router × KV-tier variants). Every KV flag exists in its image's SGLang commit (218 image × flag pairs). The round-trip / leak check reports 0 problems.
- **Arg-parse in the submission images:** all 358 commands that changed since the last validated round parse with the image's own SGLang / Dynamo parsers. `nightly-dev-20260910-00840301` (pruned) was checked with its SGLang commit's source on `nightly-dev-cu13-20260901-07c8f729`. The colocated workers' preamble was also run in bash.
- `node scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`, `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects`, `mint validate` and `pre-commit run --all-files` (in `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-cu13`) pass.
